transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Yeah, well, I guess what finally made me call the employee assistance program is that I’m just barely sleeping right. I'll lie in bed at night just... replaying work stuff, or arguments from home. And then I end up waking up around 3 or 4 in the morning anyway. By the time I actually have to get up for work, I start the day feeling like I never really rested at all.
When you're awake during the day, how do you feel emotionally? Are you often worried, or do you feel down or discouraged?

I wouldn't really say I'm worried during the day. It's more that I just feel down. Most days, it's like this... heavy, gray mood just follows me around everywhere. I'll feel it at the office, and then it's right there in the car with me, and it follows me into the house. Even when nothing specific is happening or going wrong, I just feel kind of hollow.
Have you noticed a loss of pleasure or interest in activities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or time with family and friends?

Yeah, actually, I have. I used to really look forward to things like playing pickup basketball, bowling nights, going to music festivals... even just firing up the smoker in the backyard for friends on the weekends. But lately, I don't know, I either just end up canceling my plans, or if I do show up, it feels like I'm just going through the motions. I'm there, but I'm not really getting any enjoyment out of it anymore.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or like you're not good enough, even when things aren't necessarily your fault?

Yeah, I do. I just... I keep replaying things in my head. Every late night I stayed at work, every tailgate, every dumb purchase I've made. I just think about all of it, and I end up feeling like my wife and kids got stuck with a selfish guy. It just feels like I keep letting them down.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately, like eating a lot more or less than usual?

Yeah, my appetite has definitely been off for a few months now. I'll usually just run on coffee straight through lunch, and then I just kind of pick at my dinner when I sit down with the family. But the weird thing is, I realized the other day that my belt is sitting a notch tighter than it used to. So I guess I've put on a little weight, even though I'm not really eating full meals.
Have you ever felt this way before, like this heavy mood and loss of interest, or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?

No, this is really the first time. I mean, I've had bad days or stressful quarters at work before, sure, but I've always bounced back pretty quick. I've never felt just... stuck like this for so long, where I can't even get myself to care about my normal routine. So yeah, this is definitely new for me.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the heavy mood and loss of interest in things you used to enjoy?
It's been going on for about a year and two months now. I guess... yeah, it really started right around the time the arguments at home started getting a lot worse.
Have you ever had an episode of depression before, where you felt down and lost interest in things for a period of time, or is this the first time you've experienced something like that?

Like I mentioned a minute ago, no, this is really the first time. I've never gone through a period where I felt this down or just completely lost interest in things before. So, yeah, it's all pretty new to me.
Have you ever had any other episodes of depression in the past, where you felt down and lost interest in things for a period of time, even if they didn’t last as long as this one?

No, like I was just saying, I really haven't. I mean... sure, I've had stressful weeks at work or felt bummed out for a couple of days here and there, but nothing that actually felt like this. So, no, this whole past year is definitely the first time.

Since this episode started about a year and two months ago, have you had any periods since then where you felt significantly better for a while, even if it was just for a few weeks or months, before feeling down again?

Not really, no. It's... it's pretty much just been a constant thing. I mean, I might have a decent afternoon here or there, but I definitely haven't had any weeks or months where I felt like things were back to normal. It's just been this same kind of low the whole time.
Since this low mood started, have you ever had a period where your mood was unusually high or you felt extremely energetic, even for a few days?
No, nothing like that. I haven't had any times where I felt super energetic or, you know, unusually happy or high. It's really just been this same low feeling the whole time.
Since this low mood started, have you had trouble functioning at work, at home, or in your social life because of how you've been feeling?

Yeah, it has affected things a bit. I mean, I'm still showing up to the office every day, but... my team has actually had to cover some gaps for me recently when my sales forecasts and client prep start to slip. I just can't seem to stay on top of it all like I normally do. And then at home... I'm just a lot less present with my wife and the kids than I used to be. I'm there, but I'm just not really engaging with them as much.
Have you noticed any times during the past year when your mood improved noticeably for a few weeks or more, even if it wasn't all the way back to how you felt before this started?
No, I really haven't. Like I said earlier, it's just been a steady low this whole time. I haven't had any stretches of weeks or anything where I felt noticeably better.
Have you felt a noticeable loss of energy or felt fatigued almost every day since this low mood started?

No, not really. I mean, I wouldn't say I'm completely wiped out or anything. I still get up and go to work every day, so I have enough energy to get through the basics. It's more just... a lack of motivation, I guess, rather than actually feeling physically exhausted or fatigued all the time.
